Meeting Date:                 6/25/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Misc. Transmittal
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 1-L at 654 N Lockwood Ave
                              - App No. 20771
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                         ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-L in the area bounded by:

              a line 25.0 feet south of and parallel to West Huron Street; North Lockwood
              Avenue; a line 50.0 feet south of and parallel to West Huron Street; and the public
              alley next west of and parallel to North Lockwood Avenue

to those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address; 654 North Lockwood Avenue
